items.scope: All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
All Qualys products and vulnerabilities discovered by Qualys that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All Rockwell Automation products.
Zyxel products issues only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Synaptics issues only.
OPPO devices only.
Roche’s medical technology products.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
All Cloudflare products, projects hosted at https://github.com/cloudflare/, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Cloudflare that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerability coordination for vulnerabilities in all products reported to CERT-In in accordance with our vulnerability coordination role as a CERT. Vulnerability assignments for vulnerabilities impacting all products designed, developed, and manufactured in India.

Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.

CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in information technology (IT) products discovered by European Union (EU) Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRTs) or reported to EU CSIRTs for coordinated disclosure, as long as they do not fall under a CNA with a more specific scope.
NVIDIA issues only.
All Temporal Technologies software.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Bosch products only.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
All SAP products.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Radiometer products only.
ASR products only.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by CyberArk Labs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SolarWinds products only.
Siemens issues only.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
Third-party products it researches.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Johnson Controls products only.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Yandex issues only.
All projects listed at https://openjsf.org/projects.
All CrowdStrike products.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products and services provided by Open-Xchange, PowerDNS, and Dovecot.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
